_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Monday news-cluster pre-staging day — Qwen3.5-Omni 30B-MoE multimodal closed-weights pivot (beats Gemini 3.1 Pro on audio, breaks Qwen open-source streak), OpenAI $122B fund-close coordination, Salesforce 30-feature Slackbot + Slack MCP GA pre-brief, OpenAI ChatGPT Slack + Workspace Agents pre-stage, Anthropic Dario Amodei in Canberra ahead of Tuesday Australia MOU. Research wave leans into the harness layer (Cursor Composer 2 Tech Report + Natural-Language Agent Harnesses + Trace2Skill + Learning to Commit + Lie-to-Me CoT faithfulness). Blogs cluster on ethically trained models (Mr. Chatterbox Victorian-era LLM) and agent reliability (Gerganov local-models-with-coding-agents). Slow EMAs hold the consolidating cohort firmly above the 30 gate; fast EMAs tick down on cumulative-quiet-weekend drag despite Monday volume.

sectors.name: Agents & infrastructure
sectors.description: Slack-as-MCP-control-plane day — Salesforce previews 30+ Slackbot AI features for Tuesday launch with the Slack MCP server reaching GA (Anthropic Claude back-end), and OpenAI pre-stages ChatGPT-in-Slack + Workspace Agents into the same surface. The protocol is being deployed at production scale faster than its security model is being hardened — the tension that drives all of April's MCP-security thread (today's AIP / AgentRFC carries from Sunday). Cursor's Composer 2 Tech Report + Natural-Language Agent Harnesses + Trace2Skill skill-library recipe + Learning to Commit organic-PR generation form a four-paper anchor for the harness layer.

sectors.name: Models & capabilities
sectors.description: Strategic-shift day in models — Qwen3.5-Omni breaks the Qwen open-source streak (30B-MoE / 3B-active multimodal handling text/audio/video/image in one pipeline; 256k context, 113-language speech, 215 SOTA scores Plus variant, beats Gemini 3.1 Pro on audio understanding) — Alibaba's first closed-weights flagship pivots toward direct cloud-API monetisation. Companion: CreateMoMo's small-Qwen sweep (0.8B–9B) drops the floor for self-hostable open models. Pulls the open-vs-closed conversation out of US/EU framing into Asia-Pacific stack. OpenAI 'Spud' carry; Mythos slow EMA continues to climb while fast EMA fades.
